title: Copy and compare identities
statement: Define a Box class with a public attribute content. Read a flag (1 or 0). Create an original. If the flag is 1, create another with the built-in copy function; if it is 0, make other the same object as original. Write 1 if original and other are the same object, or 0 if not.

assertions.requirement: The statement asks you to solve it with a class.
